text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving has arrived.
It's expected that a massive crowd of fans will flock to the popular model Gold City—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—The fans are gathered in the gymnasium.
I left the rest to the MC. Go check on them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Brian-senpai,
thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"If you have something to say,
say it with your own mouth."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: N-Nah, I just thought it was kinda funny seeing you work so seriously, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: She slacks off so much when she's on the rooftop and such—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm busy today. I'm leaving now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's not bad. Not good, either, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I go somewhere empty to take a breather once in a blue moon,
that person is always there slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Well, whatever.
The fans are waiting, so shall we go?"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa~~!!
City!!" her

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming, everyone.
So—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Quiet down, everyone!
Hey, no cutting in line, please!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Bamboo-senpai is the host, huh. Will she really be alright?"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Fufun, who d'you think I usually deal with on a daily basis?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
It's you we're talking about, the super troublemaker!
Taking charge should be a piece of cake—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
A two-shot of those two, no way!
Look over here--!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Do a Umatok video~~!
Do a Q&A session~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, me too?!
No, I'm supposed to be the MC today, so--

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, jump in with us, Senpai.
Holding back just isn't like you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm not holding back! 
It's just, today's your turn, so...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Well, she said it's fine, so it's all good! It's a special talk show with City × Bamboo!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Seriously simple-minded...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, does anyone have any questions?
Please raise your hands, guys!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um, you two are roommates, right?
Is there anything you know about each other that no one else does?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh.
(Clap, clap, clap, clap...!)
choice_data_list: (The question was so good it got applause...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Something only I know, you ask?
Hmmmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, please don't say anything weird, okay?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Something weird? Like how City talks in her sleep and sometimes calls me 'Papa'?

text_block_list.name: City Fan
text_block_list.text: Ooh~~!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
I'd never say that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No, they did say it, you know?
Never "Mama", but there was a time I got called "Bunny-chan".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Bunny girl...? Ah, wait!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The doll I wanted so badly back then...!
But I was too stubborn to ask for it back then...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So, you still dream about it even now?
That side of you is pretty cute, y'know~

text_block_list.name: City Fan
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaa~~~~h!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why are you screaming!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: It's all your fault...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This might be some pretty great info!
It's about City's routine!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wha— What are you—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Seriously, this person actually keeps every single letter and present she gets from fans.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"And then, whenever I get home feeling so wiped out
I could collapse, sometimes I just hug that bundle
of letters and fall right asleep!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaa!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Bamboo-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, I wasn't supposed to say that?
It's such a great story, though!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Look, people tend to see City as all cool and aloof, right?
Changing up your image here might not be a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's totally not my vibe!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
City-san actually reads my letters...
I'm so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, isn't that great?!
City-san really is full of BIG LOVE...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Still, they're happy about it, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
Geesh...
Even after that, the fan meeting continued—with one-on-one chat sessions being held next.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Um, after seeing you run, City-san,
I fell in love with you even more!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Why did you give up on the Triple Tiara?
A tiara definitely would've suited you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's—
And once the event was over—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Could you leave me alone for a bit?
There's something I want to think over.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Why I stepped off the Tiara route, huh?
